description: Implementation of CustomerOptionValueDao for accessing customer option values from the database, including methods to list by store, get by ID, and get by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerOptionValue entity, providing database access methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionValue objects for a specific store and language.
